key_insight: OuroWorld can turn a static 3D scene into a seamlessly looping 3D cinemagraph, adding realistic motion that looks vivid from any viewpoint. It does this without needing object masks, making dynamic 3D world editing much more practical.
problem_solved: Most 3D world models create photorealistic scenes that are visually impressive but frozen in time. This paper tackles the challenge of generating diverse, plausible, and view-consistent motion in existing 3D scenes while keeping the animation loop seamless.
method: Start from a static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene and infer plausible scene dynamics using a vision-language model.
Use the inferred dynamics to guide a video generation model that synthesizes a reference animated video.
Lift the reference video into multi-view videos and learn from imperfect supervision to complete the 3D motion consistently across viewpoints.
impact: For practitioners, this enables easy conversion of static 3D assets into dynamic, reusable content for AR/VR, game scenes, digital twins, and cinematic visualization. The mask-free design lowers manual effort and broadens applicability to arbitrary 3D scenes.

paper_title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
paper_authors: You-Zhe Xie, Ting-Wei Chou, Yu-Hsuan Li, Kaipeng Zhang, Zhixiang Wang
